categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in integrated security services including IoT-based security systems for commercial, residential, and institutional clients. Key segments include electronic security systems, satellite positioning and fleet management services, digital surveillance and intercom systems, fire safety systems, access control and attendance systems, property management systems, network information security services, smart construction site management, drone inspection services, and smart charging station systems. It also offers health care and emergency response services such as AED integrated solutions and elderly care services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced IoT, AI, and cloud computing technologies to develop smart security and monitoring systems. It integrates AI-powered image recognition, edge computing, and big data analytics for intelligent surveillance and disaster prevention. Manufacturing of security equipment and components is outsourced, with in-house R&D focusing on system integration, AI applications, and smart device development. The company also employs SMT automated production lines and robotic automation in its manufacturing subsidiary.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers include commercial enterprises, residential communities, financial institutions, government agencies, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, logistics and transportation companies, and individual consumers. The company serves markets requiring security, surveillance, fire safety, fleet management, and smart building management solutions. It also targets emerging markets in smart city infrastructure, elderly care, and environmental monitoring.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and services are primarily focused in Taiwan, covering the entire Taiwan region including Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Kaohsiung, and other cities. The company collaborates with Japanese partner SECOM for technology and market insights but its direct business footprint is domestic. It participates in international exhibitions and maintains global technology partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the security and safety industry supply chain. It provides integrated security solutions, system integration, and value-added services to end customers. Its subsidiaries handle manufacturing of security equipment, positioning it also partially upstream in component production. The company acts as a system integrator, service provider, and solution developer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI-enabled smart security and surveillance, expanding IoT integration, and developing smart city applications. R&D focuses on AI image recognition, smart sensor development, disaster prevention technologies, and smart home and building management systems. The company emphasizes sustainable development, ESG compliance, and energy-efficient solutions such as solar power integration and green manufacturing. It also invests in network security and virtual security services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales, leasing of security equipment, subscription and service fees for monitoring and management platforms, and value-added services such as emergency response and maintenance. The company also earns income from logistics, cash transport services, and system integration projects. Recurring revenue streams come from long-term service contracts and cloud-based platform subscriptions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a market leader in Taiwan's integrated security services industry, recognized as a pioneer and innovator. It competes with smaller local security firms and faces challenges from international entrants leveraging cloud and AI technologies. Its partnership with SECOM Japan provides a competitive edge in technology and market knowledge. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive service coverage, advanced technology adoption, and extensive nationwide service network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$17.86 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 4.6% growth over the prior year. Operating profit increased by 8.55%, and net profit grew by 10.34%, with earnings per share reaching NT$6.42. It has achieved seven consecutive years of revenue growth, demonstrating stable and solid financial performance. Total assets exceed NT$28 billion with equity around NT$13.7 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes providing customers with reliable, trustworthy, and technologically advanced security solutions that integrate AI and IoT for enhanced safety and convenience. Its unique value lies in offering comprehensive, multi-domain security services spanning food, medical, residential, and transportation sectors. The company’s smart systems reduce human labor costs, improve operational efficiency, and enhance disaster response capabilities. Its patented technologies, extensive service network, and commitment to ESG and sustainability further differentiate it in the market.
